exact_lineage.rule: Accept target flight dates, resolution, transform, geoid, latest state and survey identity only from an exact native-EPSG:27700 intersecting catalogue feature. Layer/schema availability alone is not target lineage.

wcs_numeric.rule: Use the persistent EA Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 route for raw pixel elevation. WMS imagery, documentation statistics or service-wide min/max/mean values are not parcel measurements.

hmlr_geometry.rule: Keep exact HMLR polygon matching/masking in British National Grid EPSG:27700 where possible; HMLR warns reprojection to web-map CRS can shift some features by up to 15 metres.

composite_provenance.rule: EA Composite DTM 1m may be primary only after actual raster bytes are obtained; the metadata index must identify which source survey supplied each target because repeat surveys use newest/best-resolution data.

terrain50_secondary.rule: OS Terrain 50 remains secondary corroboration. Sample the actual 50m grid at documented pixel centres and require per-tile BNG/ODN metadata and flying dates before comparison.

transport_fail_closed.rule: Web safe-open rejection and runtime DNS failure are client/transport failures, not evidence that the target has no data.

numeric_claim.rule: No parcel elevation, min/max/median/quartile, height difference, uncertainty or confidence is written until exact lineage plus real raster/archive bytes are observed and NoData is excluded.
